title: Theo and the Thorn
author: Dominic Halloran
blurb: Ulyana Zhou, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
